evidence_displayed: org.apache.commons.math3.util.MathArrays::normalizeArray NOT displayed (no requested window covers it)
rationale: All three premises check against the patch: the test data holds four NaNs and the result was NaN; the delegation chain is correctly enumerated; FastMath.tabulate adds every value without an isNaN guard (the original getMode had one). Premise 3 thus places the first wrong state (NaN entering the Frequency table) at the gold, yet the agent ranked the facade the test calls first, justified only by StatUtils.mode's javadoc stating the NaN-ignoring convention and an unverified 'correct helper should be invoked' hypothesis its own greps failed to support. StatUtils.mode is a one-line delegator whose contract is violated only via tabulate; tabulate's own doc ('each value') is neutral, so blaming the contract holder is partly defensible but misplaces the fix.
